details.claim: The explosion occurred on June 30, 1908, at 7:14 KRAT (0:14 UT).
Eyewitnesses reported a bright object streaking across the sky.
The explosion devastated over 2,150 km2 of forest.
Seismic stations recorded the event, estimating its magnitude to be near 5 on the Richter scale.
Bright nights were observed across Eurasia, with reports from as far as Stockholm and Tashkent.
